_comment: Stable objective IDs, evidence requirements and legacy-index mapping for the five pilot cases of Task 5. Authored 2026-09-04 by decomposing each case's OWN critical-action sentence — where the sentence names two things joined by 'and', that is two substeps and mode allOf; where it offers alternatives, anyOf. No clinical requirement has been added that the case did not already state.
_note: AUTHORED, NOT CLINICIAN-REVIEWED. The judgement that needs Kim specifically is allOf versus anyOf: whether both halves of a sentence are genuinely required, or either will do. Guessing that wrong is how a partially-treated patient gets full marks. Recognition and avoidance objectives are marked legacyOnly and are NOT migrated — the plan keeps those heuristics on the legacy path.

Immediate needle decompression

Work the Hs and Ts and name the cause
Decompress the chest on the side of the line attempt
Ventilate, and confirm with waveform capnography
Definitive chest tube once there is a pulse, confirmed on a film
ICU with a 12-lead and temperature management
Recognise the appendicitis pattern
Labs, and a pregnancy test in a woman of reproductive age
Imaging chosen appropriately — ultrasound first in children and pregnancy, CT in uncertain adults
Analgesia, IV fluids, and nil by mouth
Antibiotics
Surgical consultation for appendicectomy
Recognise complicated disease
Continuous nebulised salbutamol with ipratropium, and high-flow oxygen
A systemic steroid early, and magnesium sulfate
Low rate with a long expiratory time, and disconnect to let the chest deflate
Compressions and the PEA algorithm on losing the pulse
Epinephrine 0.01 mg/kg every 3-5 minutes
A 20 mL/kg fluid bolus for obstructive shock
